pairing.method: nearest ERA5 0.25° cell centre with land_sea_mask ≥ 0.5 to the gauge outlet

not_compared.why: ERA5 0.25° has specific humidity on pressure levels only (1000 hPa and up), no 2 m humidity

climatology_note: Hourly anomalies: minus the (calendar day, UTC hour) mean smoothed over ±15 days; daily: minus the calendar-day mean
